title: singular.orchestration.ctx-experiment-armstate.v0
description: A deterministic, strictly read-only snapshot of the OBSERVED continuity knob-state for one run: the per-arm configuration provenance the experiment-report attributes escape-rate / cost / bias to (control = M0 knob-state with every continuity knob inactive at its documented default; treatment = the continuity knobs set/enabling). Emitted by reading ONLY the engine's own SINGULAR_* continuity knobs from the process environment; it records nothing and gates no node. Keys are sorted and deterministic for a fixed environment. A partial or non-enabling value is carried verbatim with active=false. Additive under the singular.orchestration.*.v0 namespace; validation fails closed.

knobs.description: One record per canonical continuity knob that distinguishes treatment from the M0 control baseline, keyed by the knob's canonical SINGULAR_* name. Every knob is always present so the object fully documents either arm.

activeCount.description: The number of continuity knobs reported active. 0 is the M0 control knob-state.

knob.description: The knob's canonical SINGULAR_* environment-variable name.

value.description: The observed environment value, carried verbatim (the documented default when unset).

active.description: The boolean interpretation the engine itself applies: set-and-enabling versus unset / 0 / empty / non-enabling.
